query:
WITH raw_input AS (
    SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
        $3::TEXT[],$4::TEXT[],$5::TEXT[],$6::BIGINT[],
        $7::BIGINT[],$8::SMALLINT[],$9::TEXT[]
    ) AS value(dir_id,component,value,changed_at,client_seq,version_rank,event_id)
), input AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (dir_id,component) * FROM raw_input
    ORDER BY dir_id,component,changed_at DESC,version_rank DESC,client_seq DESC,event_id COLLATE "C" DESC
)
INSERT INTO sync_directory_state(
    library_id,dir_id,component,value,changed_at,client_id,client_seq,version_rank,event_id
)
SELECT $1,dir_id,component,value,changed_at,$2,client_seq,version_rank,event_id FROM input
ON CONFLICT (library_id,dir_id,component) DO UPDATE SET
    value=EXCLUDED.value,changed_at=EXCLUDED.changed_at,client_id=EXCLUDED.client_id,
    client_seq=EXCLUDED.client_seq,version_rank=EXCLUDED.version_rank,
    event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id,server_seq=DEFAULT;
